# Accuracy Plus Medical Laboratory — Genetics

> Accuracy Plus Medical Laboratory (مختبر أكيوريسي بلس الطبي) in Abu Dhabi, UAE offers genetic testing with genetic counselling before and after every result, and home sample collection across Abu Dhabi.

## Genetic tests
- Premarital and expanded carrier screening, including thalassaemia, sickle cell and spinal muscular atrophy. Open to all couples in the UAE. Results in about 2–3 weeks.
- NIPT (non-invasive prenatal testing) from 10 weeks of pregnancy, with optional microdeletions. Results in about 5–7 days.
- Fertility and IVF genetics: PGT-A, PGT-M, couple karyotype, Y-chromosome microdeletion.
- Whole exome sequencing, whole genome sequencing, clinical exome, trio analysis, chromosomal microarray. Results in about 4–8 weeks.
- Hereditary cancer: BRCA1 and BRCA2, hereditary cancer panels, Lynch syndrome. Results in about 2–4 weeks.
- Oncology: tumour profiling, liquid biopsy (ctDNA), myeloid and lymphoid panels, HRD testing.

## Key facts
- Accredited by the College of American Pathologists (CAP) and by EIAC to ISO 15189.
- Serving Abu Dhabi since 2017.
- Variants are classified with the ACMG five-tier system and reported in HGVS nomenclature.
- Patients can book without a referral for most tests.
- Premarital genetic testing has been mandatory for Emirati citizens since January 2025; Accuracy Plus offers carrier screening to all couples.
